text: Good evening, I'm so sorry to trouble you at this hour. I'm looking after my granddaughter, she's 4, and I think her temperature was 37.6 but I'm not completely sure I used the thermometer right. She's had runny poos a few times today, though she's drinking plenty and weeing as normal I believe. Her left eye has gone pink and a bit sticky, crusty in the corner. I had a good look over her for any rash and couldn't see anything at all, so I don't think there's anything there. Her parents are away and I may just be fussing. Apologies again.
